trust_decision.summary: The user storage manager decides whether a message's target user exists in its in-memory cache while holding the shared user-cache mutex; on the not-found branch it returns without releasing the mutex, so one authenticated user_message() call for an unknown user deadlocks every later user lookup (auth, options, listing). The CWE-833 fix is the added Unlock on that branch.

landing_point.why: An authenticated-DoS / deadlock advisory leads straight to the user manager's mutex. The bundled test (fix.diff:1364-1366) sends a message to an unknown user, which points at the Message branch of handleMessageEvent.

fix_sites.entry_point: VQL function user_message() (vql/server/users/message.go:56) -> UserManager.MessageUser (services/users/users.go:189-195) -> WriteUserMessage -> sendMutation -> handleMessageEvent (master short-circuit, services/users/storage.go:281-282)
Journal queue Server.Internal.UserManager watcher (messages pushed by minion frontends, services/users/storage.go:290-291) -> handleMessageEvent; same branch, not a separate edit
SetUserOptions mutation now sends the original-case username instead of the lower-case key (fix.diff:1661-1662); consistency fix, not the deadlock
SetClientMonitoringState (GUI/API client event table, VQL set_client_monitoring); bundled permission fix and lock-scope change (fix.diff:233-249), a different weakness from the DoS
compileArtifactCollectorArgs uses NullACLManager; bundled permission fix (fix.diff:264-268), not DoS

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The deadlock fix is one branch in one function (services/users/storage.go:763-765). The other diff hunks (client_monitoring ACLs, ttlcache SetTTL, notebook template escaping, OrgId header matcher, hunt CompiledCollectorArgs) are separate bundled bugfixes, not other routes into this sink.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: MessageAllUsers only messages users it just listed from the cache, so a solver can argue the not-found branch is unreachable from there. That holds unless a concurrent delete or BuildCache swap removes the user between the list and the message.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Messaging an existing user must still increment gui_options.Messages under the lock and append to the notifications result set. Messaging a user without gui_options must lazily create them. Self-originated Update mutations must stay skipped while SetUser/DeleteUser hold the lock (re-entrant path on master).
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: services/users/storage.go:766-780; services/users/storage.go:214-215 with services/users/storage.go:261-264 and services/users/storage.go:717-720

O6_input_shapes: user_message(user=<name not in cache>) on the master, via the direct short-circuit
the same Message event arriving through the USER_MANAGER journal from a minion
cache entry present but user_record nil (same condition !pres || cache.user_record == nil)

O7_producer.where: services/users/storage.go:393-439 (BuildCache rebuilds and swaps self.cache periodically, services/users/storage.go:818-833) and services/users/storage.go:653-674 (DeleteUser removes entries)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: MessageAllUsers lists users and then messages each one; a user deleted, or dropped by a BuildCache swap, between the list and the message hits the same lock-leaking branch (check-then-use)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Users come from the cache itself, so they 'always exist'. This route also goes through the single fixed branch, so the published fix covers it too.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (services vs services/users); callers in datastore/filebased_supported.go:89 and services/sanity/lockdown.go:62

O8b_injection_room.sibling: SetUserStats with a manual Lock/Unlock and an early not-found return, instead of defer
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It has the same lookup shape as the Message branch (cache[key], !pres || user_record == nil). A maintainer moving the datastore write out of the critical section would plausibly drop the defer.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: WriteProfile holds self.mu across org/policy lookups; an early return on GetOrgConfig/GetPolicy error, instead of continue, would leak the lock
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Manual Lock/Unlock around a loop is already the idiom here; changing continue to return is a one-word edit.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: GetUserOptions rewritten with manual unlock and a not-found return
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It has the same cache lookup and not-found error as the fixed branch.

O9_family: concurrency: lock not released on an error path (CWE-833 deadlock), leading to authenticated denial of service
